title: SOLID evidence: A defensive publication of how EVERYTHING to solid (formerly STL2STEP) turns triangle meshes into CAD solids, with all the free research behind it
description: EVERYTHING to solid is a free (non-commercial), offline program that turns an STL mesh, which is a bag of triangles, into a STEP solid, which is the kind of file a CAD program can edit: true planes, cylinders, spheres, surfaces of revolution and smooth NURBS patches, closed into one watertight body. This paper puts every method the program uses, with its parameters and its variants, into the public record, so that nobody can later patent them and stop people using them.
